chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:

"Not a single day has come upon the people of the world since Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created it, except that the sky in it sends down rain; then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, places that wherever He wills."

key_terms.السَّمَاءُ: the sky from which rain descends

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe Allah’s control over rain and its distribution in the world?
ai.summary: This hadith states that rainfall is a continual divine act in the world and that its distribution occurs by the will of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. It highlights Allah’s ongoing governance of creation and His control over sustenance and natural processes.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Not a single day has passed for the people of the world since Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, created it, except that the sky sends down rain, and Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, places it wherever He wills."
